thread:
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window: 2026-03-23 01:00-02:30 UTC. Target: runtime kernel patch + model runtime pin for models: rwd/gptx-3. Expected: config rollout, possible brief degraded requests for some Dedicated customers. Link: https://deploys.redwood/status/1728888888

maria: heads-up — Support needs statuspage + SMS copy. I'm starting a draft below, please review quickly.

maria: ```Statuspage copy draft:
We're applying a runtime patch to improve inference stability on 23 Mar 01:00–02:30 UTC. Some Dedicated customers may see short interruptions; most requests will be served normally. We'll provide updates here and notify affected accounts by SMS if disruptions occur.
Advice: no action required; contact support if you see persistent errors.
``` 

devon: small wording tweak — change to 'may see short interruptions' and drop ETA unless we can commit.

rahul: ops plan: canary in eu-west-1, then eu-central, then us-west; if error rate >3% for 10m we pin previous runtime and roll back kernel. I'll add runbook to PagerDuty.

sasha: will run smoke checks and watch KV cache miss rate + p50 latency. If we spike I'll hold rollout and trigger rollback plan. Also recommend pre-baking fallback models for customers with SLA.

support_lead: SMS audience: only customers with active Dedicated contracts in affected regions. We'll include opt-out link and ticket id. Draft SMS below.

devon: SMS draft: "Redwood: Possible brief service interruptions during maintenance 23 Mar 01:00–02:30 UTC. Affected Dedicated customers will receive updates. Reply STOP to opt out."

maria: updated statuspage w/ devon's wording and removed ETA. Also added note about SMS opt-out. Draft link: https://confluence.redwood.internal/ops/status-drafts/1728888888

support_lead: ack — I'll queue SMS to only affected segments after canary completes. Please confirm rollback criteria one more time (rahul?).

rahul: rollback: if error rate >3% AND 95th latency >500ms for 10m post-rollout OR if customer-reported critical incidents >2 within 15m, trigger immediate pin rollback and notify CS. Decision authority: oncall-eng lead + ops lead.

sasha: noted. I set alert thresholds on the dashboard. I'll post canary smoke results in this thread at +15m increments.

devon: LGTM. Once canary green, support to send SMS. If not, pause and we draft a broader status update.

maria: thanks all — target timeline: canary starts 01:05 UTC, decision at 01:25 UTC. I'll publish statuspage 'update in progress' when canary begins. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary started in eu-west-1 at 01:05 UTC. Link: https://deploys.redwood/canary/1728888888

sasha: first 15m smoke: p50 ok, error rate 0.6%, KV miss stable. Holding for next check.

devon: :thumbsup:

support_lead: queued SMS but not sent. Waiting green.

maria: publishing statuspage now — short note about 'we're monitoring'.

sasha: second check at 01:25 — p95 rose to 520ms for 3 minutes, error rate spiked to 3.6% for 6m. I'm pausing rollout and starting rollback.

rahul: initiating pin rollback now. Notifying CS and oncall.

deploy-bot: Rollback triggered by rahul at 01:29 UTC. Rollback job id: rb-1728888888-1

maria: updating statuspage to note rollback and we'll send SMS to affected customers with rollback notice + follow-up when complete.

support_lead: SMS go: "Redwood: We observed an elevated error rate during maintenance and have rolled back to the previous runtime. Service is being restored. We'll follow up if action is needed. Reply STOP to opt out."

devon: good short copy.

sasha: rollback completed at 01:35 UTC. Metrics returning to baseline.

rahul: postmortem trigger: ops + eng-platform; initial RCA scheduled 03/24 10:00 UTC. I'll own rollout checklist updates.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll file statuspage final update and keep CS posted. Thread closed after postmortem notes are linked.
